items.statement: The calculation uses NI(O)-Qu as E-styryl, neutral zwitterionic, closed-shell singlet and documents geometry/convergence.
items.expected: Identity, charge 0, multiplicity 1, E stereochemistry and optimization status/criterion are explicit.

items.statement: Frontier localization is evaluated against named naphthalimide and quinolinium fragments with reproducible evidence.
items.expected: Separate evidence is supplied for both orbital localizations.

items.statement: The NI(O)-Qu HOMO energy is reproduced.
The NI(O)-Qu LUMO energy is reproduced.
The frontier topology has the reported fragment pattern.
items.expected: HOMO predominantly naphthalimide and LUMO predominantly quinoline.
